brief: 6 internal tools every AI startup ships in week 1 — concrete examples.

slots.title: 1. Prompt Lab, the proving ground
slots.body: A stripped-down UI where engineers test system prompts against edge cases with live token counts and latency metrics before any customer sees them.

slots.title: 2. Admin Panel, the mission control
slots.body: A Supabase-backed dashboard showing user signups, API quota burn, and daily inference costs so founders catch spikes before the bill arrives.

slots.title: 3. Support Bot, the first responder
slots.body: A Slack-integrated agent that triages #support tickets, drafts replies from the knowledge base, and escalates to engineers with full context.

slots.title: 4. Ingestion Pipe, the memory builder
slots.body: A Notion-triggered pipeline that chunks product docs, embeds them into Postgres with pgvector, and refreshes the index on every edit.

slots.title: 5. Preview Env, the safety net
slots.body: Vercel Preview deployments for every PR that spin up isolated staging databases so prompt changes never touch production data.

slots.title: 6. Notetaker, the context keeper
slots.body: A Zoom bot that joins user research calls, transcribes audio, extracts feature requests, and drops structured tickets into Linear.

slots.headline: Ship Yours This Week
slots.subline: Steal this sequence to ship fast and stay sane. Which tool are you building first?
